eventProjection.primarySource: named raw EventBinding longOutput/shortOutput after historical warm-up coercion and cross-timeframe alignment
eventProjection.rawMissingRule: only null/NaN historical visual-alignment values coerce false; finite events must be exact booleans or 0/1
eventProjection.freshEventDefinition: every active completed decision-clock event bar
eventProjection.eventStartDefinition: false-to-true transition using the exact immediately preceding completed decision-clock event state, including the retained warm-up predecessor
eventProjection.m15PrimaryClock: M5 decision clock at M15 completed bar plus 10 minutes with no raw forward-fill

correctedForwardResponse.v3ExcursionSpan: retained as historical diagnostic only; it is not V4 favorable-minus-adverse asymmetry
correctedForwardResponse.volatilityNormalization: only emit the exact historical forward_response_atlas_v1 calculation if byte-for-byte formula parity is demonstrated; otherwise unavailable with reason

sterileOutputs.featureExtraction: two fresh outcome-inaccessible processes must produce byte-identical V4 corpora before child outcomes open
sterileOutputs.s2: a separate pre-child-outcome parent-entry authority and sealed parent_entry_conditioned evidence use only exact parent records, component projections, recovered bars, and entry timestamps
sterileOutputs.rawProjectionRetention: large raw timestamped projections may remain ignored locally, but their exact schema, row count, path, and SHA256 must be bound by the V4 seals

analysisContract.phenotypeHandling: retain lexicographic outcome-blind representative as a named view and report exhaustive 60-combination representative sensitivity and/or exact fractional weighting
analysisContract.contextHandling: report and, where sample size permits, rank/center inside parentCandidateId + side + insertion route/site; parent-only pooling is sensitivity only
analysisContract.lopoLabel: within_parent_descriptor_association unless an actual frozen train-other-parents/predict-held-out-parent model exists
analysisContract.multiplicity: report every frozen horizon and fixed-seed max-absolute-rho family-wise permutation; do not select a favorable horizon or fit outcome-selected weights
analysisContract.crossPanel: P3 sealed feature to P1 and P2 outcomes separately, with success on both reported
